settings.title: CFBL Clinical Services
settings.description: Therapy, psychological evaluation, groups, and consultation for individuals and families. Trauma-based treatment for mental health across the lifespan.

settings.title: CFBL Institute
settings.description: Continuing education for professionals seeking integrated training in trauma. Live workshops and on-demand courses built for licensed clinicians.

settings.title: CFBL Publications
settings.description: Books, essays, and longer-form writing on psychology, memory, and being human. Writing by Dr. Angela Serravalle for readers everywhere.

settings.heading: Individual Therapy
settings.description: One-on-one therapy for adults and adolescents navigating trauma, anxiety, grief, and identity. Evidence-based, trauma-based, and tailored to your goals.

settings.heading: Psychological Evaluations
settings.description: Comprehensive evaluations for children, adolescents, and adults. Diagnostic clarity that informs treatment planning, school supports, and clinical decision-making.

settings.heading: Wellness Groups
settings.description: Community-grounded groups focused on grief, parenting, and somatic resourcing. Structured and time-limited, with open enrollment periods.

settings.heading: One practice. Three doors.
settings.subheading: Center for Balanced Living, CFBL Institute, and MUSA are three distinct properties under one roof — each serving a different audience with its own voice and editorial identity.

settings.name: Dr. Angela (Niki) Serravalle
settings.bio_short: A trauma-based psychologist, educator, and writer. Founder of the Center for Balanced Living, the CFBL Institute, and MUSA.

settings.title: Trauma-Based Assessment: Integrating the ACEs Framework
settings.description: Integrating psychometric reasoning with somatic and nervous-system awareness. A six-hour workshop for LCSWs, LPCs, psychologists, and PMHNPs.

settings.lede: The body keeps a record that the mind is still learning to read. What clinical work reveals about the strangeness of traumatic memory.
